decision.words: abandon the ten most unworkable topics

registered_by: captain lane 3, 6 Oct 2026 -- committed BEFORE the ranking was computed (scripts/g1_abandon_rank.py reads this file at its commit and records the rule's sha256 and that commit)
disclosure: Before writing this rule the captain had seen each topic's G1 state, N eligible and open-gap count (outputs/k_gap/g1/*.json), but not any score. The weights below were not tuned afterwards; a change to this rule is a new rule ID.
population: the 32 served topics (docs/reviews/<slug>/review.json with a tracker file outputs/k_gap/g1/<slug>.json)
excluded_from_abandonment: every topic whose tracker g1_status.state is G1_MATCHED at the ranking commit -- the live strict matches AND the topics matched locally against an adopted comparator pending the V8 signature (dpp4-mace-t2d, esketamine-trd-madrs)

inputs_committed_artefacts_only.N_eligible: tracker N_eligible (comparator trials eligible under our registered protocol)
inputs_committed_artefacts_only.open: tracker open_gaps (eligible comparator trials not matched)
inputs_committed_artefacts_only.closed: open gaps whose blocker class (text before the first ':') is in CLOSED -- the open routes are exhausted or the trial cannot be reached through open sources
inputs_committed_artefacts_only.swap_adopted: 1 if registry/comparator_selection/<slug>.adoption.json exists (a pre-registered replacement comparator is adopted, pending signature), else 0

score: U = closed/N_eligible + 0.5*open/N_eligible - 0.5*swap_adopted   (higher = less workable; N_eligible = 0 scores 0)
selection: rank the non-excluded topics by U descending; ties broken by larger closed count, then by slug ascending; ABANDON the first 10
status_of_abandoned: ABANDONED_BY_DECISION: nothing is deleted; pages, rows and findings stay served and linked; an abandoned topic can never count as matched; the 32-topic line stays on /g1/ beside the active-topic line
